visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in an airport arrival hall. A group of adults and children stand behind a glass barrier. A woman in a red shirt holds a bouquet of white flowers and waves frantically. To her left, a man in a white shirt records with a smartphone. The background is a brightly lit terminal with signage and other passengers waiting. (2) The camera follows the woman in the red shirt as she begins running across the terminal floor. She is accompanied by a young boy in a white t-shirt. They navigate through a crowd of people. In the distance, a young girl with a backpack and luggage appears. (3) The woman in red reaches the girl and embraces her tightly. The girl is holding a small bouquet. They are surrounded by other travelers and luggage carts. The lighting is consistent with indoor airport facilities. (4) The scene shifts to a new segment with different clothing. A young girl in a gray dress and a woman in white wait at the barrier, holding large yellow bouquets. They wave their arms high in the air. Other people around them are also holding signs and waiting. (5) The girl and woman start running through the terminal towards the arrival gate. They pass by digital flight information boards and seating areas. The camera movement is handheld and shaky, following their rapid motion. (6) They reach another girl wearing a mask and a hoodie. They embrace her warmly. The girl being welcomed has multiple pieces of luggage. (7) In a third segment, a woman with long dark hair sits and laughs while looking at her phone. A young girl sits next to her, waving at the camera. They are in a waiting area with yellow floor markings. (8) The woman in a purple jacket stands and waves excitedly towards the arrival gate. She starts running across the open terminal floor, weaving through other people. The flooring is polished and reflects the overhead lights. (9) She reaches a girl in a white hoodie and gives her a long hug. The girl has a large backpack and a suitcase. (10) The final scene shows an older man sitting calmly on a bench in the background. He is wearing a leather jacket and a cap, sitting with his legs crossed, shaking his foot slightly, appearing detached from the surrounding excitement.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched female shouting "Ali! Ali!" repeats over a fast-tempo, upbeat electronic piano melody. The tone is extremely energetic and joyful. Background airport terminal chatter is present but faint. (2) A rapid rhythmic thudding sound mimicking footsteps triggers as the woman begins to run. The speech rate of the shouting increases, matching the visual motion. (3) A loud squealing laugh and the sound of heavy breathing occur as the hug happens. A comic 'pop' sound effect marks a transition. (4) A different female voice shouts "Hello! Sister is coming!" with a high-rising intonation. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (5) Another sequence of rapid footstep sound effects (SFX) accompanies high-energy laughter and cheering from multiple female voices. (6) The sound of luggage wheels rolling on a hard surface is audible amidst the shouting. A comedic 'ding' sound effect plays. (7) Clearer conversational laughter between two women is heard, followed by a loud enthusiastic "Woo!" cheer. The music swells slightly. (8) Sustained shouting of "Welcome back!" in Mandarin with very high vocal arousal. The spectral brightness is high due to the sharp female vocal peaks. (9) The audio ends with a comedic synthesized sound effect as the focus shifts to the calm grandfather, contrasting with the previous high-energy vocalizations.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a compilation of heartwarming family reunions at the airport, highlighting the excitement and love felt when family members return from long study abroad trips.
